title: Voice-synthesis-friendly tooltips + localized timing for cost animations
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Improve accessibility and internationalization of micro-interactions in the Console cost views and rollout widgets by making tooltips and in-chart animations friendly to screen readers/voice synthesis and by localizing animation timing so that translated copy does not truncate or overlap.

Scope: prototype and review for cost sparklines, cost card tooltips, rollout percentage animations, and toast/tooltips used in rollout rollups. Deliverables: Figma prototype with alternate motion states, annotated spec for devs (WCAG references), JS+ARIA guidance, and acceptance tests for both a11y and i18n teams.

Acceptance criteria:
- Tooltips expose concise aria-labels and role="tooltip" with aria-describedby where appropriate; tooltip text is not duplicated in the accessible name.
- Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion and an additional user-toggle in Console settings.
- Animation durations and text-transition offsets are dynamically scaled by localized string length so that voice-synthesis reads complete phrases without being interrupted by motion-based removal.
- Color choices for tooltip backgrounds, text, and animated accent lines meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast (4.5:1 for normal text) and a fallback palette is provided for high-contrast mode.
- Prototype demonstrates how a live region (aria-live="polite") is used for cost change deltas so screen readers announce deltas without overwhelming users during rapid updates.
- Document provides i18n notes: pluralization hooks, ICU examples for English/FR/JA, and number formatting hooks for region-aware separators and currency.

Design notes / trade-offs:
- We propose using aria-live polite updates for summarized delta announcements instead of announcing every token-level change to avoid noisy narration. The tradeoff: slightly delayed summary for users relying on screen readers versus immediate visual feedback.
- For brief tooltips, we prefer aria-describedby linking to the tooltip node rather than aria-label on the triggering control so that translations remain single-source.
- To keep motion lightweight, dynamic scaling uses a simple heuristic: baseDuration * max(1, localizedLength / baselineLength). This adds minimal runtime cost but requires l10n team to flag exceptionally long translations.

Dev guidance (high level):
- Provide CSS variables for token colors and durations: --cost-tooltip-bg, --cost-tooltip-foreground, --cost-anim-duration.
- Use IntersectionObserver + requestAnimationFrame for timing-based sequencing; cancel animations when prefers-reduced-motion or when aria-hidden.
- Implement a server-side or build-time check that flags translations longer than 140% of the English baseline and surfaces examples in the Console translation review panel.

Testing notes:
- Manual a11y pass with VoiceOver and NVDA reading: ensure live region summaries are intelligible and not duplicated.
- Automated contrast checks for all tooltip color variants.
- L10n QA across EN/FR/DE/JA including currency and thousands separators.
comments: 2025-03-05 - Aisha Khan: Initial prototype uploaded to Figma. Included three motion states: default, reduced-motion, and user-disabled. Requested feedback from Eng on runtime hooks and from L10n on dynamic duration heuristic.

2025-03-06 - Miguel Santos: Reviewed prototype. Asked for explicit aria-live example snippets and to avoid duplicate announcements when tooltips also expose aria-describedby. Noted that current rollout toasts remove text before screen reader completes reading in Japanese example.

2025-03-08 - Priya Desai (L10n): Ran translations on FR/JA demo. FR text expanded ~1.6x and caused overlap in the current 800ms animation window—recommending we adopt the scaling heuristic and flag long translations during build.

2025-03-10 - Accessibility review: Contrast passes for primary palette, failing for tertiary accent in high-contrast scenarios. Recommendation: swap to semantic tokens --color-accent-strong when high-contrast preference detected.

2025-03-12 - Miguel Santos: Updated spec with code snippets for aria-live polite region and sample CSS variables. Asking ENG-12013 to implement the reduced-motion user-toggle and expose the tooltip variables in the design tokens layer. Moving to In Review.
